facts.value: Accounting is essential to every business, providing the structure and insight needed to stay compliant, profitable, and informed.
Due to its importance, accountants enjoy strong pay, steady demand, and career flexibility across nearly any industry.
The work performed by accountants is at the heart of modern financial markets.
Without accounting, investors would be unable to rely on timely or accurate financial information.
Companies’ executives would lack the transparency needed to manage risks or plan projects.
Regulators also rely on accountants for critical functions such as providing auditors’ opinions on companies’ annual 10-K filings.
